title: Periphrastic Impersonalization: 'Megállapításra került'
goal: I can use *-ásra/-ésre kerül* and *kihirdetésre vár* in an official report.
I can say what an applicant received with *részesül* (*támogatásban részesült*).
I can tell an official report from everyday speech.

sections.title: Unit 8: Institutional Impersonalization & Passive Avoidance
body: Official Hungarian avoids naming who acted. It does this with fixed phrases (*megállapításra került*, *elutasításban részesült*) and with nouns in *-ás/-és*.
In this unit you will practise official phrases that leave out the doer, stacked nouns in *-ás/-és*, court claims against an authority, and a text about Kálmán Mikszáth and the county offices.

sections.title: Lesson Goals

I can tell an official report from everyday speech.
